content.text:
The test passes.

I added a client search box to the Clients feature. The change:

- **`src/main/frontend/features/clients/feature.tsx`** — added a `search` state and a `client-search` input, and rendered a `visible` list filtered by a case-insensitive substring match on the client name. An empty box shows all clients.

The backend and schema already supported listing clients (`/api/clients`, the `clients` table, and the `/__test__` seed path all handle clients), so this feature only needed the front-end filtering layer — kept additive and local to the clients feature, composing the existing `client-row-*` / `client-name` anchors the spec expects.
